title: AiMemoryResult
description: ai.memory-result@1 (OpenVibe.AI; Memory M2): what the memory API answers: a list of items (GET /items, the batch import), one item (GET or PATCH /items/{id}), the cached profile (GET /profile), a count of deleted rows (DELETE) or the agent search's items (GET /search, at most 8, active only). The text is the person's own and is never logged.

text.description: The cached summary of the person's own notes for this scope. It passed noLooks before it was stored.

items_hash.description: sha256 of the sorted item MACs the profile was built from.
